biotools.summary: Zero-dependency client-side JavaScript and TypeScript alpha-matting and foreground segmentation kernel engineered for privacy-preserving brightfield microscopy, colony morphology plates, macroscopic pathology specimen photography, and clinical image preparation inside local browser memory (WebGPU, WebAssembly, and TypedArray Web Workers). By executing neural saliency segmentation (RMBG-1.4), deterministic 3D Euclidean RGB and perceptual CIE76 Lab color-keying, topological breadth-first search (BFS) aperture detection, Joint Bilateral 4K upsampling, separable O(W*H) morphological boundary refinement, and iterative foreground color decontamination entirely on the client workstation with zero network payload transmission, the library enables IRB- and HIPAA-aligned specimen background isolation without uploading unpublished or sensitive imagery to external cloud servers.
